name: An opposite-faction group member receives Spirit of Life with their own faction (#11266)
contract: Issue #11266. The client colours and offers attacks from UNIT_FIELD_FACTIONTEMPLATE, so the server-side reaction fix of #7692 left Spirit of Life 840002 red to opposite-faction group members. With AllowTwoSide.Interaction.Group, Unit::PatchValuesUpdate sends a player-controlled unit to a hostile-faction raid member with the viewer's faction. Spirit of Life is summoned by script with UNIT_FLAG_PLAYER_CONTROLLED but is not a minion, so the patch now also accepts that flag. An Orc Primalist (faction 2) is grouped with a Human warrior (faction 1): the warrior must receive faction 1 for the spirit, while the summoner itself still receives faction 2.

steps.label: SETUP: the group member is Alliance
SETUP: Spirits of Life summons a Spirit of Life
CONTRACT: the Alliance group member receives the spirit with its own faction
CONTROL: the summoner receives the spirit's real faction
